properties.text: Receipt encoding prefix byte must match the transaction type (0x01-0x04 or legacy).
properties.assertion: forall tx, receipt: encode_receipt(tx, receipt) => prefix_byte(result) == type_map[typeof(tx)]

properties.text: Transaction type must be one of the five supported types; reject unknown types.
properties.assertion: forall tx: typeof(tx) in {Legacy, AccessList, FeeMarket, Blob, SetCode}

properties.text: LegacyTransaction receipts must not have a type prefix byte prepended.
properties.assertion: forall tx: typeof(tx) == Legacy => encode_receipt(tx, r) == rlp.encode(r)

properties.text: Decoded receipt first byte must be in {1,2,3,4} when receipt is typed (Bytes).
properties.assertion: forall r: isinstance(r, Bytes) => r[0] in {1, 2, 3, 4}

properties.text: Receipt decoding must strip the type prefix byte before RLP decoding.
properties.assertion: forall r: isinstance(r, Bytes) => rlp.decode_to(Receipt, r[1:]) == decode_receipt(r)

properties.text: Non-Bytes receipt must already be a Receipt object and returned unchanged.
properties.assertion: forall r: !isinstance(r, Bytes) => decode_receipt(r) == r && isinstance(r, Receipt)

properties.text: Withdrawal must have all four fields set: index, validator_index, address, amount.
properties.assertion: forall w: Withdrawal => w.index != null && w.validator_index != null && w.address != null && w.amount != null

properties.text: Withdrawal object must be immutable (frozen) after construction.
properties.assertion: forall w: constructed(w) => is_frozen(w) && !is_mutable(w)

properties.text: Block header must have all 21 fields set in construction order before freezing.
properties.assertion: forall h: Header => count(fields(h)) == 21 && all_non_null(fields(h))

properties.text: In PoS, header difficulty must be constant and nonce must be zero.
properties.assertion: forall h: Header => h.difficulty == 0 && h.nonce == Bytes8(0x0)

properties.text: Header ommers_hash must always equal EMPTY_OMMER_HASH in post-merge forks.
properties.assertion: forall h: Header => h.ommers_hash == EMPTY_OMMER_HASH

properties.text: base_fee_per_gas must follow EIP-1559 adjustment rules relative to parent block.
properties.assertion: forall h: Header => h.base_fee == eip1559_base_fee(parent(h))

properties.text: blob_gas_used and excess_blob_gas must follow EIP-4844 computation rules.
properties.assertion: forall h: Header => h.excess_blob_gas == calc_excess(parent(h)) && h.blob_gas_used <= MAX_BLOB_GAS

properties.text: requests_hash must follow EIP-7685 computation from execution requests.
properties.assertion: forall h: Header => h.requests_hash == sha256(encode_requests(block.requests))

properties.text: Block ommers tuple must always be empty in PoS forks.
properties.assertion: forall b: Block => len(b.ommers) == 0

properties.text: Block transactions may only contain supported transaction types.
properties.assertion: forall b, tx: tx in b.transactions => typeof(tx) in {Legacy, AccessList, FeeMarket, Blob, SetCode}

properties.text: Block object must be immutable (frozen) after construction.
properties.assertion: forall b: constructed(b) => is_frozen(b) && !is_mutable(b)

properties.text: Log topics tuple must have at most 4 elements (LOG0-LOG4 opcodes).
properties.assertion: forall l: Log => len(l.topics) <= 4

properties.text: cumulative_gas_used must be monotonically non-decreasing within a block.
properties.assertion: forall r_i, r_j: i < j => receipts[i].cumulative_gas_used <= receipts[j].cumulative_gas_used

properties.text: Receipt bloom filter must be consistent with the logs in the receipt.
properties.assertion: forall r: Receipt => r.bloom == logs_bloom(r.logs)

properties.text: Bloom filter bytearray must be exactly 256 bytes.
properties.assertion: forall bloom: Bloom => len(bloom) == 256

properties.text: add_to_bloom bit_to_set value must be in range [0, 2047] via 0x07FF mask.
properties.assertion: forall entry: add_to_bloom(bloom, entry) => forall i in {0,2,4}: (keccak(entry)[i:i+2] & 0x07FF) <= 2047

properties.text: add_to_bloom byte_index must always be in range [0, 255].
properties.assertion: forall entry: add_to_bloom(bloom, entry) => forall bit_to_set: (0x07FF - bit_to_set) // 8 <= 255

properties.text: add_to_bloom loop must iterate exactly 3 times, setting 3 bits per entry.
properties.assertion: forall entry: add_to_bloom(bloom, entry) => bits_set_count == 3

properties.text: logs_bloom must initialize bloom to all zeros (256 zero bytes) before processing.
properties.assertion: forall: logs_bloom(logs) => initial_bloom == bytearray(256)

properties.text: Every log address must be added to the bloom filter exactly once.
properties.assertion: forall log in logs: add_to_bloom_called(bloom, log.address) == 1

properties.text: Every topic of every log must be added to the bloom filter exactly once.
properties.assertion: forall log, topic: topic in log.topics => add_to_bloom_called(bloom, topic) == 1

properties.text: P2P peers are untrusted; all received blocks/receipts must be fully validated.
properties.assertion: forall peer, msg: peer.trust_level == UNTRUSTED => validate_all(msg) before accept(msg)

properties.text: Engine API is JWT-authenticated; only authenticated callers may submit payloads.
properties.assertion: forall caller: engineAPI.newPayload(caller, p) => caller.hasValidJWT == true

properties.text: Data from EL via Engine API may not be fully verified by CL; corrupted data may propagate.
properties.assertion: forall data: engineAPI.response(data) => CL.verify(data) || flag_unverified(data)

properties.text: Malformed RLP in receipt decoding must cause rejection, not partial decode.
properties.assertion: forall r: !valid_rlp(r[1:]) => decode_receipt(r) raises InvalidBlock

properties.text: Receipt with unknown type prefix byte (not 1-4) must be rejected with assertion error.
properties.assertion: forall r: isinstance(r, Bytes) && r[0] not in {1,2,3,4} => raises AssertionError

properties.text: Blocks with non-empty ommers in PoS must be rejected during validation.
properties.assertion: forall b: len(b.ommers) > 0 => reject_block(b)

properties.text: encode_receipt and decode_receipt must be inverse operations for all transaction types.
properties.assertion: forall tx, r: decode_receipt(encode_receipt(tx, r)) == r

properties.text: Header object must be immutable (frozen) after construction of all 21 fields.
properties.assertion: forall h: constructed(h) => is_frozen(h) && count(fields(h)) == 21

properties.text: add_to_bloom is called (1 + len(log.topics)) times per log entry in logs_bloom.
properties.assertion: forall log: calls_to_add_to_bloom(log) == 1 + len(log.topics)

properties.text: Block header with missing or null fields must be rejected before state transition.
properties.assertion: forall h: any_null(fields(h)) => reject_block(block_of(h))

properties.text: Withdrawal index field must be of type U64; amount must be of type U256.
properties.assertion: forall w: Withdrawal => typeof(w.index) == U64 && typeof(w.amount) == U256
